description: In this luminuous appartment, you can gather with family and friends to visit Paris !The spaceFACADE RENOVATION FINISHED Located on the 3rd floor with elevator, this appartment in greens will be your best place to visit Paris.The kitchen is equipped with all amenities to cook during your stay and a dishwater to help you out. With the 5 simple beds and the convertible sofa bed for 2, the flat can easily accomodate 7 people. The 2 complete bathrooms with toilets are all accessible. Towels, shower gel, shampoo, mirror, hair dryer, washing machine and drying rack are provided fpr greater confort. We are delighted to host you in our appartment which is cleaned between each stay.Guest accessThe entire apartment is available.Other things to note***EQUIPMENT AVAILABLE***• Air conditioning / Heating• Washing machine / dryer • Hair dryer • Television (Freebox) •Kitchen equipment • For the exhaustive list in the “what this accommodation offers” tab.***CONSUMABLE PRODUCTS AND TOWELS***Please note that our accommodation is not a hotel. Coffee capsules, tea, toilet paper, soap, shower gel, shampoo, trash bag will be provided on arrival as a starter pack. We do NOT charge during your stay. One large towel per person is provided for the entire stay. One small towel per bathroom is provided for the entire stay to clean hands. These towels will NOT be washed and changed every day.Thank you for your understanding, we do not have the same human and material resources as a hotel.

enrichment.summary: Two-bedroom flat on the third floor with an elevator, five listed single beds, and a convertible sofa bed for two. The host advertises two bathrooms, both with toilets, and a kitchen with dishwasher. Photos show at least five dining seats; step-free access from the street is not established.
